quota.label: Active contacts (non-archived)
quota.exhausted: You've reached your contact limit. Archive inactive contacts or upgrade your plan.

empty.searchDescription: Adjust your search or filters, or clear filters to see all contacts.
empty.archivedDescription: Archived contacts stay here and can be restored anytime.
empty.initialDescription: Import a CSV or add your first contact manually to start building your audience.

editor.description: Manage contact email, name, and tags.
editor.complianceBody: Contacts without declared consent are saved as Unconfirmed and cannot receive campaigns, protecting your sender reputation.
editor.tagPlaceholder: Type tags (press comma or Enter to add)
editor.tagTooLong: Each tag can be at most 30 characters.
editor.tagsLimitReached: Each contact can have at most 20 tags.
editor.consentCheckbox: I confirm this contact explicitly opted in to marketing emails
editor.consentCheckboxHint: Checking this marks the contact as Subscribed and eligible to send. Source and note are recorded as proof of consent; otherwise the contact stays Unconfirmed.
editor.consentSourcePlaceholder: e.g. Store checkout opt-in, trade show card
editor.consentNotePlaceholder: e.g. Customer opted in to promotional emails at checkout
editor.saveFailedKeepInput: Save failed. Your input was preserved — please try again.

unsubscribeDialog.title: Confirm manual unsubscribe
unsubscribeDialog.description: Manually unsubscribing adds this email to your suppression list. Future imports won't re-subscribe it.
unsubscribeDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Requested by customer, invalid address

archiveConfirm.title: Archive contact
archiveConfirm.description: Archive {email}? You can restore them anytime from Archived.

toast.unsubscribeFailed: Failed to unsubscribe. Check your connection and try again.

failure.keepJob: Your job is saved. Retrying checks existing progress — do not re-upload.
failure.keepInput: Your input is preserved. Edit if needed and retry.
failure.fileReadFailed: Failed to read local file. Your existing list was preserved — please choose the file again.
failure.prepareNetworkFailed: Preview request did not complete. Your input is preserved — check your network and retry.
failure.processNetworkFailed: Request did not complete. Check your network and resume this job; committed records are preserved.
failure.loadNetworkFailed: Failed to load results. Current job and page are preserved — check your network and retry.
failure.reportNetworkFailed: Report download failed. Check your network and retry.

form.sectionDescription: Up to 1,000 rows and 2 MiB per import. Preview does not modify contacts.
form.textHint: Paste comma- or tab-separated rows. Without a header row, columns are read as email, name, tags.
form.fileHint: UTF-8 CSV with an "email" (or 邮箱) column header; up to 1,000 rows and 2 MiB.
form.fileKeepPaste: Pasted text is kept until you choose a file.
form.consentLead: Importing contacts does not grant send permission. Unconfirmed contacts cannot receive campaigns, and existing unsubscribes, complaints, hard bounces, or archives are preserved.
form.consentCheckbox: I confirm contacts in this list explicitly opted in to marketing emails
form.consentCheckboxHint: Applies to rows without a subscription status; per-row CSV values take precedence. Otherwise new contacts import as Unconfirmed.
form.consentUncheckedHint: Bulk declaration is unchecked. Entered consent fields will still be submitted and can be edited or cleared below, but won't mark unconfirmed contacts as Subscribed.
form.consentAtHint: Uses your device time zone and cannot be in the future.
form.consentNotePlaceholder: e.g. Opted in to promotional emails on sign-up; verifiable in admin
form.csvHelpSummary: How to fill per-row CSV consent?
form.csvHelpLine1: The subscription_status column accepts unconfirmed, subscribed, unsubscribed, bounced, or complained. Subscribed rows require consent_source and consent_note.
form.csvHelpLine2: When consent_source, consent_note, or consent_at columns exist in the CSV, per-row values take precedence (empty cells are not filled from bulk fields).
form.busyHint: Processing current request — wait until it finishes before switching lists.
form.nextHint: Next, review new, updated, protected, and error rows before importing.

validation.textRequired: Paste contacts or choose a CSV file with data.
validation.consentSourceRequired: Enter the consent source proving opt-in.
validation.consentAtInvalid: Enter a valid consent time no later than now.

history.title: Recent imports
history.description: Keeps your last 10 imports to resume or review results.
history.empty: No imports yet. Jobs appear here after preview.
history.pendingConfirmCount: {count, plural, one {# item awaiting confirmation} other {# items awaiting confirmation}}

results.descPreview: No contacts have been modified yet. Review the breakdown before confirming.
results.descCompleted: Processing finished. Review any errors and protected records below.
results.descProcessing: Processing in batches — wait for the current request to finish before switching jobs.
results.descResume: Progress is saved on this job. Resuming processes only remaining records — no re-upload needed.
results.descFailed: This job cannot be resumed. Download the report, fix your source file, and start a new import.
results.countsHint: Unique emails counts valid distinct addresses; error rows are kept separately, so counts may differ. Does not represent sendable recipients.
results.suppressedPreviewNote: {count, plural, one {# record will be added to the suppression list and will not be emailed.} other {# records will be added to the suppression list and will not be emailed.}}
results.suppressedActualNote: {count, plural, one {# record was added to the suppression list and will not be emailed.} other {# records were added to the suppression list and will not be emailed.}}
results.keptHint: "Skipped / kept" includes unchanged contacts, archived skips, and preserved suppression statuses; profile details on protected contacts may still be filled.
results.editDraftHint: Going back preserves your input; re-previewing creates a new job while keeping this preview. Starting a new import clears your input.
results.savedPreviewHint: This is a saved preview job. The original file isn't stored on this page — fix the source rows and start a new import.
results.busyHint: Finishing current request — creating, paging, or switching jobs is temporarily disabled.
results.protectionTitle: Import results and send eligibility are checked separately
results.protectionLine1: Unconfirmed contacts cannot receive campaigns; existing unsubscribe, complaint, hard-bounce, and archive protections are never removed by imports.
results.protectionLine2: "Requested status" shows what this import requested. "Unconfirmed" never downgrades existing subscribers; check Contacts for each contact's final status.
results.errorHintCanEdit: Error rows are not saved; valid rows still follow normal rules. Fix rows by line number or go back to edit and preview again.
results.errorHintReadOnly: Error rows are not saved; valid rows still follow normal rules. Fix rows by line number in your file and start a new import.
results.completedToast: Import completed — review results and subscription statuses

explanations.archived_skipped: Contact is archived and will not be restored automatically.
explanations.suppressed_protected: Preserves existing unsubscribe, complaint, or hard-bounce protection; profile details may still be updated.
explanations.suppressed: Protected based on unsubscribe, complaint, or hard-bounce status in the list; will not be emailed.
explanations.unchanged: Existing details need no update and subscription status stays unchanged.
